Rule.name: HR CSV - Diagnose
Rule.Description:
Read-only troubleshooting rule. Changes nothing. Checks, for one identity: 1. the identity mappings stored in the database (ObjectConfig "Identity") 2. the copy of that config IIQ has cached in memory (used by refresh) 3. the HR account (link) values 4. the values stored on the identity 5. what the Status rule returns when run directly
Run it from the IIQ console: rule "HR CSV - Diagnose" To check someone other than 1000, change IDENTITY_NAME below.
